changes.summary: Removed required attribute that selected how guide content was generated (Manual, Prompt, or Document).
Removed optional prompt used when source was Prompt.
Removed optional URL used when source was Prompt.
Removed computed guide status (Draft or ProductionReady).
Removed computed latest saved version identifier.
Removed computed latest production-ready version identifier.
Removed optional attribute that controlled draft vs publish workflow (Draft, ProductionReady, or TestReady).
Refresh no longer populates status, source, latest_saved_version, or latest_production_ready_version; plans may show these values removed from state after upgrade.
Refresh no longer populates state; plans may show state removed from state after upgrade.
Create always sets source to Manual and no longer reads source, prompt, or url from configuration.
Create no longer runs prompt-based content generation or automatically creates an initial guide version; manage content with genesyscloud_guide_version separately.
Create always attempts to publish the version to ProductionReady; draft-only creation via state is no longer supported.
When the parent guide already has a production-ready version, update creates a new version instead of patching the existing one; otherwise it updates the latest saved version.
Update always attempts to publish the version to ProductionReady.
When create fails because the latest version is not production-ready, the provider retries by updating the existing version instead of requiring a 409 response.
Exported configuration includes only name; source, prompt, and url are no longer written to generated Terraform.
Export includes only each guide's latest saved version, no longer exporting a separate production-ready version when it differs.
Export resolves resources.data_action.data_action_id references to genesyscloud_integration_action resources.
Export omits generate_content from generated configuration.
